limitations: Two generated worlds with seat swaps are not a broad win-rate estimate.
Quiet directed cases are correlated and last 180 seconds.
Native landing and on-foot sensors, snapshot creation, and publication validation remain outside the shared work allowance.
Powered mode reuses v12 capture behavior, including continuous walking, so differences can occur without a jetpack launch.
No Raspberry Pi performance measurement or default change.
